verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Entra ID automatically provisions users and groups into downstream apps over SCIM. Coverage includes SaaS apps like Dropbox, Salesforce and ServiceNow, a gallery of SCIM-enabled apps, and on-premises or VM-hosted apps without opening firewalls. That clearly delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: evidence that entitlements or app roles are pushed (not just users and groups), evidence that provisioning fires immediately on access assignment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
